media.caption: A water jar with women at a fountain, c.510–500 BCE. A represented scene is not a census of later Athenian life.
notice: Locate the two side handles and the pictured containers.
Compare the work shown with the function of the jar.
The painted scene does not identify each figure’s legal status.
